commit_message:
[Torch] Register RestructureNonConstantAxes in the Torch input pipeline
The torch-to-iree input pipeline did not schedule RestructureNonConstantAxes,
so ONNX reductions with a runtime axes tensor kept a runtime `dim` and failed
to legalize in ConvertTorchToLinalg with:
  failed to legalize operation 'torch.aten.sum.dim_IntList'

Although the pass is registered and visible in `iree-opt -help`, it was never
run by default `iree-compile`. This schedules it before ConvertTorchToTMTensor
so runtime single-element reduction axes (keepdims=1) are statically resolved
and lower cleanly to linalg.

Also adds a lit smoke test running the full torch-to-iree pipeline to guard the
pass stays scheduled, and updates the onnx_ops cpu_llvm_sync O0/O2 xfail configs.

Fixes 28 reduce cases(improving onnx_ops pass counts: 864 -> 892 passed (O0), 893 passed (O2)).

Part of #24378

Assisted-by: Claude Code, Doubao, DeepSeek

Signed-off-by: Yalong <yalong@multicorewareinc.com>
name: setup / setup

Executable canonicalization and CSE were added to a copy of the nested
pass manager, so they were discarded before the Flow pipeline ran. Keep
the manager owned by the pipeline so executable canonicalization and
common-subexpression elimination actually run and appear in the
serialized pipeline.

[Codegen] Make loop allocation lifetime ownership explicit

Allowing loops to return fresh allocations requires the caller to
arrange deallocation. Make this ownership obligation explicit at the
call site so opting in cannot be mistaken for a bufferization-only
policy change.

[Flow] Retain nested executable pass manager by reference

Executable canonicalization and CSE were added to a copy of the nested
pass manager, so they were discarded before the Flow pipeline ran. Keep
the manager owned by the pipeline so executable canonicalization and
common-subexpression elimination actually run and appear in the
serialized pipeline.

Assisted-by: OpenAI Codex
Signed-off-by: Christopher McGirr <mcgirr@roofline.ai>
Co-authored-by: DavidGinten <ginten@roofline.ai>

commit_message:
[Torch] Register RestructureNonConstantAxes in the Torch input pipeline (#25041)

The torch-to-iree input pipeline did not schedule
RestructureNonConstantAxes,
so ONNX reductions with a runtime axes tensor kept a runtime `dim` and
failed
to legalize in ConvertTorchToLinalg with:
> failed to legalize operation 'torch.aten.sum.dim_IntList'

Although the pass is registered and visible in `iree-opt -help`, it was
never
run by default `iree-compile`. This schedules it before
ConvertTorchToTMTensor
so runtime single-element reduction axes (keepdims=1) are statically
resolved
and lower cleanly to linalg.

Also adds a lit smoke test running the full torch-to-iree pipeline to
guard the
pass stays scheduled, and updates the onnx_ops cpu_llvm_sync O0/O2 xfail
configs.

Fixes 28 reduce cases(improving onnx_ops pass counts: 864 -> 892 passed
(O0), 893 passed (O2)).

Part of iree-org/iree#24378

commit_message:
[Torch] Register RestructureNonConstantAxes in the Torch input pipeline (#25041)

The torch-to-iree input pipeline did not schedule
RestructureNonConstantAxes,
so ONNX reductions with a runtime axes tensor kept a runtime `dim` and
failed
to legalize in ConvertTorchToLinalg with:
> failed to legalize operation 'torch.aten.sum.dim_IntList'

Although the pass is registered and visible in `iree-opt -help`, it was
never
run by default `iree-compile`. This schedules it before
ConvertTorchToTMTensor
so runtime single-element reduction axes (keepdims=1) are statically
resolved
and lower cleanly to linalg.

Also adds a lit smoke test running the full torch-to-iree pipeline to
guard the
pass stays scheduled, and updates the onnx_ops cpu_llvm_sync O0/O2 xfail
configs.

Fixes 28 reduce cases(improving onnx_ops pass counts: 864 -> 892 passed
(O0), 893 passed (O2)).

Part of iree-org/iree#24378

commit_message:
[Torch] Register RestructureNonConstantAxes in the Torch input pipeline (#25041)

The torch-to-iree input pipeline did not schedule
RestructureNonConstantAxes,
so ONNX reductions with a runtime axes tensor kept a runtime `dim` and
failed
to legalize in ConvertTorchToLinalg with:
> failed to legalize operation 'torch.aten.sum.dim_IntList'

Although the pass is registered and visible in `iree-opt -help`, it was
never
run by default `iree-compile`. This schedules it before
ConvertTorchToTMTensor
so runtime single-element reduction axes (keepdims=1) are statically
resolved
and lower cleanly to linalg.

Also adds a lit smoke test running the full torch-to-iree pipeline to
guard the
pass stays scheduled, and updates the onnx_ops cpu_llvm_sync O0/O2 xfail
configs.

Fixes 28 reduce cases(improving onnx_ops pass counts: 864 -> 892 passed
(O0), 893 passed (O2)).

commit_message:
[Torch] Register RestructureNonConstantAxes in the Torch input pipeline
The torch-to-iree input pipeline did not schedule RestructureNonConstantAxes,
so ONNX reductions with a runtime axes tensor kept a runtime `dim` and failed
to legalize in ConvertTorchToLinalg with:
  failed to legalize operation 'torch.aten.sum.dim_IntList'

Although the pass is registered and visible in `iree-opt -help`, it was never
run by default `iree-compile`. This schedules it before ConvertTorchToTMTensor
so runtime single-element reduction axes (keepdims=1) are statically resolved
and lower cleanly to linalg.

Also adds a lit smoke test running the full torch-to-iree pipeline to guard the
pass stays scheduled, and updates the onnx_ops cpu_llvm_sync O0/O2 xfail configs.

Fixes 28 reduce cases(improving onnx_ops pass counts: 864 -> 892 passed (O0), 893 passed (O2)).

Part of #24378

commit_message:
[Torch] Register RestructureNonConstantAxes in the Torch input pipeline (#25041)

The torch-to-iree input pipeline did not schedule
RestructureNonConstantAxes,
so ONNX reductions with a runtime axes tensor kept a runtime `dim` and
failed
to legalize in ConvertTorchToLinalg with:
> failed to legalize operation 'torch.aten.sum.dim_IntList'

Although the pass is registered and visible in `iree-opt -help`, it was
never
run by default `iree-compile`. This schedules it before
ConvertTorchToTMTensor
so runtime single-element reduction axes (keepdims=1) are statically
resolved
and lower cleanly to linalg.

Also adds a lit smoke test running the full torch-to-iree pipeline to
guard the
pass stays scheduled, and updates the onnx_ops cpu_llvm_sync O0/O2 xfail
configs.

Fixes 28 reduce cases(improving onnx_ops pass counts: 864 -> 892 passed
(O0), 893 passed (O2)).

Part of iree-org/iree#24378
